name: Canto Now Playing
author: Gustavo Costa (gusthx)
description: What Canto is playing, in the bar: previous / play-pause / next and the title, or the current synced lyric line, shown whole in pages. A small popup shows the cover and the lyric around the current line.

barWidget.description: Canto controls and now playing. Click the text to switch between the title and the synced lyric line; right-click for the popup.

schema.label: Show previous / play-pause / next
schema.description: Small transport buttons before the text. Off leaves the text alone; clicking it still switches modes, and scrolling still skips.

schema.label: Text shows
schema.description: title: Title · Artist. lyric: the current synced line (needs Visual Bridge on in Canto: Preferences, Integrations, Visual Bridge). Clicking the text in the bar switches it and saves the choice here.

schema.label: Maximum text width
schema.description: The widest the text gets, in pixels before scaling. A longer lyric line is shown in pages that fit; a longer title is cut with an ellipsis.
